propositions: The agentic path re-sends accumulated tool-result message history uncached on every turn, causing input cost to grow O(N^2) in conversation turns

Cache settings currently enable only system and tool-definition breakpoints but not message-tail caching, leaving the growing history unbilled to cache despite available pydantic-ai configuration knobs
Telemetry cannot detect the uncached message tail because the system breakpoint alone produces nonzero cache_read_tokens, preventing cache-ineffectiveness warnings from firing
Anthropic and Bedrock arms require different cache configuration keys (anthropic_cache vs bedrock_cache_messages) due to provider-specific API constraints, and Bedrock rejects top-level cache_control
Single-turn execution paths must remain byte-identical to prevent regression, confirmed by captured request diffing before and after enabling message-tail caching
